topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's core themes of cancer evolution, cell of origin, and the tumor microenvironment along with the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic Mutations and Epigenetic Dynamics in Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how successive genetic driver mutations and transient epigenetic alterations confer competitive fitness advantages to drive clonal selection and expansion.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate the cancer stem cell model and present experimental evidence for stem cell origins and hierarchies in leukemias and colorectal cancers.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion, Cellular Interactions, and Integrated Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They demonstrate how inflammatory and stromal microenvironments enable malignant outgrowth, how these spatial interactions are experimentally investigated, and how these factors synthesize into a Darwinian model of cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Next Session Preview
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
